priority: P1 — validate TagDuel lobby cancellation and confirmed team concession through the actual Discord component handler, preserving locks, physical card identity, LP and private hands.

behavior: An invited non-host can refuse a partially accepted lobby; the session becomes cancelled, revision increments, all tag_members locks are released and currentTag becomes empty for every participant.
Nonparticipants and wrong-guild interactions are rejected before Discord acknowledgement; stale duplicate cancellation and stale confirmation cannot mutate the saved session.

An inactive physical partner can open the quit confirmation and concede for their team; confirmation finishes the duel, releases seat locks, preserves all physical card UIDs and shared LP, and does not reveal private hand UIDs.
implementation.validation: The test invokes createTagLobby, acceptTag, tagPublicMessage, tagPrivateMessage and handleTagComponent with real Discord.js builders, validateDiscordPayload and a temporary SQLite database.

limitations: Discord component handlers and payload builders are exercised offline; no live guild, bot token or real Discord API call.
SQLite and player profiles are temporary fixtures; no production player, collection, deck or database is modified.
This is a test/evidence/workflow change only; no runtime command, card effect, catalogue, certification or allowlist change.
